descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S26 Save & Extract fails, is slow, is retried or is tapped twice: dictation kept, tasks unchanged or applied once, a clear message

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U14 When task extraction fails or is slow, the physician sees a visible in-progress state and then a clear message and can retry (or the backup model answers, recorded per 3.9); … (UAT 3.5; UAT OAT-03)
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8; TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident, each with typed tasks 'follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks'; trackActionRequests on ai/parsing:extractTasks (e2e/support/action-observer.ts) with failFirst, then a mocked success that closes BMP and PT a …

When (1) Type the UAT bedside text and tap Save & Extract while the call fails. (2) Tap again (mocked success). (3) Tap again without changing the text (same mocked answer). (4) On a fresh chart, tap Save & Extract twice within 300 ms. (5) With the 35 s delay, watch the screen until the answer. Each in both contexts; …

Then (1) 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.'; the encounter text still in the box and stored; the stored tasks deep-equal to before (nothing closed, nothing added). (2) BMP and PT done once, the diet task once, weight open. (3) Nothing added or changed. (4) One extractTasks request, or the button disabled while 'Extracting…'; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U14 from 3.5 / OAT-03 ('the physician is never left waiting with nothing'), U3 as read in Q5 (c), U10 (no dictated words lost). Judged on the stored tasks and the visible text, with the model mocked, so this is evidence for the app, not the extractor. The Hospital failure message alone is already asserted by the existing spec in S17; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

Judged on the then only; a failure message left on screen after a successful retry is recorded (not in the then). (4)'s two taps are fired inside the page, 120 ms apart. — Scripted socket answers (fail / success / delayed), DOM reads and JWT reads.

Spec ext-tc22-s26-fail.spec.ts (copy of tc22-extract-fail.spec.ts with numeric task ids and its own evidence). Hospital 9/9 + 2/2, Nursing Home 9/9 + 2/2: (1) 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.', text kept in the box and stored, tasks unchanged; (2) BMP and PT done once, the diet task once, weight open; (3) a repeat tap changes nothing; (4) two taps 121–123 ms apart → one request, button already disabled; (5) 'Extracting…' in all 35 samples of a 35 s answer, then the result. Recorded only (not in the then): in Nursing Home the failure also raises the global red banner, which is still on screen after the successful retry ('✓ Tasks updated — 2 completed, 1 added' under 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed…'); Hospital clears its message. Same as on e02167f.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): failFirst / mocked / 35 s delayed ai/parsing:extractTasks answers through action-observer and backend reads on a fresh local account; dev has no admin key and no action mock, and a real failure cannot be forced there, so it runs on the local stack only…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
